summary.text: STEIN MAGNUSSEN BAKERI AS (887 652 422), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2004-12-07; address P.A. Kvaals gate, 8459 MELBU, Norge. Main industry is Manufacture of bread; manufacture of fresh pastry goods and cakes (10.710); 29 registered employees; 2 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Linn Magnussen; Board chair: Jostein Magnussen; Auditor: REVICOM AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 10.98 m, operating profit NOK 450.61 k, net profit NOK 449.96 k, equity NOK 1.55 m, total assets NOK 3.87 m.

statements.text: Works in manufacture of bread; manufacture of fresh pastry goods and cakes (industry code 10.710); also registered for retail sale of bread, cake and confectionery. Stated purpose (Norwegian, from the register): Produksjon og butikksalg av bakevarer og konditorvarer, samt annen virksomhet som naturlig faller inn under dette, herunder delta i andre selskaper som driver med lignende virksomhet. I tillegg drive med eie, forvaltning og utleie av fast eiendom.
